verdicts.where: Finding 1 (medium): standings(.zh).svg footer, "theorems that state a row of the same record at a model, verified on the core run" / 「…在核心运行中核验过」

The gloss puts "verified on the core run" right after "theorems that state a row", so a reader takes the stating itself as checked. shared_laws.py l.40-42 says "That the theorem states the row's statement is a reader's judgment; this tool verifies what the Lean can show and computes the rest". F5-MODEL-STATEMENTS.md §1 says "That `declaration` states what `of` states is a reader's judgment, which Lean does not show", and each item also declares "the review that checked this item". 08 §7 l.448 and the table rows 458-459 say only "by F5's verified items". 08 l.437 says "each proved through its row and declared on its row's record" and does not say the stating is checked. So the gloss is wider than its home. Medium is right. The proposed fix keeps the home's qualifier and is small.
